ANZ Bank’s customer deposits, lending up in June quarter
results.description: Australian bank ANZ has posted a mildly improved third-quarter result, showing that its New Zealand unit, ANZ Bank, enjoyed gains in customer deposits as well as net loans and advances. The Australian deposit taker, which is the parent of NZ’s largest bank by total assets, produced an A$1.90 billion (NZ$2.29b) cash profit for the three months to the end of June, up 2% on the same period in 2025.

results.description: The Philippines has secured a 200-million euro loan (about ₱14 billion) from the French government, through Agence Française de Développement (AFD), for the country's protection of its marine ecosystems resources and expansion of opportunities in the blue economy.
